_doc: Owned-item registry for reverse-flip eligibility (PLAN-REVERSE-FLIP RF0). Tracked repo-root store, AGENT-WRITTEN via pipeline/commands/declare-owned.mjs (seed/classify/list); mirrors ignored-items.json's {_doc, items:[]} shape. An item's live owned qty is a COMPUTED rolling balance — seedQty + net buy/sell delta over fills.json events with ts >= seedTs (pipeline/lib/ownedledger.mjs computeOwnedQty) — NEVER a hand-edited field (same idempotent-rebuild-from-full-history philosophy positions.json uses). classification: 'keep' (owned, want to keep — THE reverse-flip candidate pool: RF2 surfaces classification:'keep' items, RF1's oscillator filter + Ben's per-run table selection do the candidate-picking, no persistent opt-in flag per Ruling 8) | 'flip' (normal merch item, not owned-for-keeping — the default for anything unclassified) | 'consumable' (used up, not a market position). source: 'seed' (one-time curated baseline / bank paste) | 'capture' (captured from a big-ticket small-qty buy the log saw). Per-item shape when populated: {id,name,seedQty,seedTs,classification,source}. Ships EMPTY — Ben populates real owned items via the CLI. NO PII (ids/names/prices only; repo is public).
